name: red-01-legacy-equality-pin
purpose: RED before implementation. The public behavior of qualifyEdge() (record the actual version and SHA, fail closed for a missing binary, an unsigned or invalid or foreign or look-alike publisher signature, majors 155 and 157, unparsable versions, a hanging signature query, a binary that changes mid-check, and the proof that an equality pin on 156.0.4314.50 fails on 156.0.4314.58) against qualify.cjs as a stub that reproduces what the 57 browser-pin suites do today: an equality pin on 156.0.4314.50 and nothing else. Every test must fail on a behavioral assertion; the module is loadable.

notOk: anything but a Valid signature fails closed with SIGNATURE_NOT_VALID
a validly signed binary of another publisher or a look-alike name fails closed
a Valid signature with no certificate subject at all fails as PUBLISHER_NOT_MICROSOFT
an invalid signature of a foreign publisher reports both problems
majors 155 and 157, a wildcard-like 1560 and a zero major fail closed with MAJOR_NOT_QUALIFIED
an unusable qualified list fails closed with QUALIFIED_MAJORS_INVALID
an unparsable file version fails closed with VERSION_UNPARSABLE and is not recorded as the version
a missing, null, non-string or throwing version read fails closed with VERSION_UNAVAILABLE
a signature, version or hash query that never answers fails closed with a timeout code and returns
a throwing or malformed adapter answer fails closed instead of crashing
a binary that changes while it is checked fails closed with EDGE_CHANGED_DURING_CHECK
a Microsoft-signed Edge inside the qualified majors passes and records its actual identity
no historical build number is compared: .50 and .58 and a later build of major 156 all qualify
the binary hash is recorded and never compared with a historical value
a missing binary fails closed with EDGE_NOT_FOUND and lists every checked candidate
a candidate that is a directory fails closed with EDGE_NOT_A_FILE
the first existing candidate is the one that is qualified, later ones are only listed
an explicit path skips discovery and is recorded
an equality pin on 156.0.4314.50 fails on the installed 156.0.4314.58 while qualifyEdge passes
